Delicious cuisine in a warm setting
Jun 2026 • Friends
We had a great time with friends! It was a big first for me and, despite the rather intimate size of the restaurant, I was totally won over. It is a place full of charm and originality, with a very warm welcome and a great atmosphere.

The food was absolutely delicious, with every dish bursting with flavor. We particularly enjoyed the appetizers, and the selection was truly varied. Everything we tasted was flavorful and prepared with great care.

Special mention for the service, which was truly top-notch! The host and the entire team were super welcoming, attentive, and very available, without ever being intrusive or rushing us out. The drinks and dishes were served at the right time, which made the experience even more pleasant.

We had a wonderful time and we highly recommend Steak Haus. We will certainly be back very soon, we hope!

Nice surprise at one hundred Tunis
May 2026 • Family
During one evening, looking for a place to eat in the center of Tunis, we were directed to this restaurant by a local gentleman who warmly pointed us to this place to eat. We were really satisfied with the quality: excellent meat accompanied by Tunisian beer! From the environment, very local and untouristy and from the service: young and very good guys. Note of credit to the owner who stayed to talk to us, advising us what to take and personally taking care that our dishes were prepared with care and that everything was perfect. 
Recommended for anyone who wants to spend a pleasant evening in the center of Tunis

Los Angeles, California5 contributions

Run, don’t walk.
Oct 2025 • Family
My daughter and I visited this restaurant our last night in Tunis. It was late, and we were very hungry. Steak Haus did not disappoint. The steak with pepper sauce was one of the best meals we had eaten all week, and everything on the plate was delicious. Our waiter Riadh was nothing short of lovely, and made us feel welcome and special. We had foolishly spent all our dinars, and thought we could pay by credit (cash only), and Riadh graciously walked us to the ATM. We only wish we had discovered the restaurant earlier, but now we have another reason to return to Tunis.
